rows.best_observables: GPU telemetry, power swings, NVLink/fabric bursts, profiling
rows.failure_mode: Too short to establish sustained run; maxima can look like training during benchmarks.
rows.recommended_use: Use for feature extraction: p95, bursts, autocorrelation, and periodicity. Do not label likely/definite from a single spike.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Detects step-level bursts and instantaneous maxima.

rows.best_observables: Cloud launch events, scheduler starts, fabric bursts, GPU utilization
rows.failure_mode: Can hit peak utilization without knowing whether the run persisted.
rows.recommended_use: Use to assign possible/elevated and to trigger longer-window aggregation.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Good for candidate-window detection and launch/provisioning clustering.

rows.best_observables: Scheduler allocations, GPU/power utilization, fabric cadence, storage reads/writes
rows.failure_mode: May still confuse large benchmarks, HPC, or batch inference.
rows.recommended_use: Use for elevated/likely if two independent primary signals align.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Good for distinguishing sustained jobs from benchmarks or transient autoscaling.

rows.best_observables: GPU-hours, billing continuity, power CV, storage checkpoints, runtime stability
rows.failure_mode: Short training runs can be diluted if averaged over a full week.
rows.recommended_use: Use rolling windows and duration-above-threshold features.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Good for large fine-tunes, medium pretraining, and sustained training/HPC campaigns.

rows.best_observables: Billing, scheduler GPU-hours, power continuity, checkpoint/export history
rows.failure_mode: Short bursts can be hidden unless max/duty-cycle features are retained.
rows.recommended_use: Use for final run classification and aggregate compliance reporting.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Best for high-confidence large-run labels and negative certification over an audit period.

rows.best_observables: Monitoring integrity, attestation, coverage, physical changes
rows.failure_mode: Missingness can be mistaken for no activity.
rows.recommended_use: Always include coverage and gap features; never impute missing layers as zero.
rows.what_it_can_label_well: Determines whether absence of evidence is meaningful.
